{'text': '從 iOS 27.2 開始，開發人員將可以選擇在歐盟使用替代版的「應用程式追蹤透明度」(App Tracking Transparency) 系統提示，作為 Apple 近期與歐盟達成協議的一部分。以下是詳細內容。', 'source': "[0] Starting with iOS 27.2, developers will be able to opt-in to an alternative version of the App Tracking Transparency system prompt for use in the European Union, as part of Apple's recent agreement with the EU. Here are the details."}

{'text': '新版提示於部分歐洲國家強制使用', 'source': '[1] New prompt mandatory in some European countries'}

{'text': '數週前，Apple 確認將會遵守歐盟「更公平」的「應用程式追蹤透明度」規則，此前德國聯邦卡特爾署 (Federal Cartel Office) 曾就此展開調查。', 'source': '[2] Several weeks ago, Apple confirmed it would comply with "more equitable" App Tracking Transparency rules in the EU, following an investigation by Germany\'s Federal Cartel Office.'}

{'text': '此協議結束了歷時多年的反壟斷調查，該調查旨在釐清 Apple 的 ATT 規則是否較其自家服務對第三方應用程式構成不公平的不利影響。Apple 一直否認相關指控，聲稱其從根本上對自家應用程式同樣奉行嚴格的私隱原則。然而，德國監管機構對此並不信服。', 'source': "[3] The agreement ends a years-long antitrust investigation into whether Apple's ATT rules posed an unfair disadvantage to third-party apps relative to its own services. Apple has denied the allegations, claiming that it fundamentally follows strict privacy principles for its own apps as well. However, German regulators were not convinced."}

{'text': '因此，Apple 同意對歐洲的 ATT 框架作出八項更改，你可以從此頁阅读更多相關內容。', 'source': '[4] As a result, Apple agreed to make eight changes to the ATT framework in Europe, which you can read more about here.'}

{'text': '話雖如此，Apple 今日確認 iOS 27 將允許開發人員自行選擇是否「在歐盟使用替代版的『應用程式追蹤透明度』系統提示」，並補充指「基於法律要求，僅有替代版系統提示適用於在德國、法國、意大利、波蘭及羅馬尼亞分發的應用程式」。', 'source': '[5] That said, Apple today confirmed that iOS 27 will allow developers to opt in to "an alternative version of the App Tracking Transparency system prompt for use in the EU," adding that "based on legal requirements, the alternative system prompt only applies to apps distributed in Germany, France, Italy, Poland, and Romania."'}

{'text': '在「用戶私隱與數據使用」(User privacy and data use) 開發人員支援頁面的更新中，Apple 詳細說明了該替代版系統提示的內容：', 'source': '[6] In an update to its "User privacy and data use" developer support page, Apple detailed what the alternative system prompt entails:'}

{'text': 'Apple 進一步表示，歐盟的開發人員亦將可以在用戶作出上一次 ATT 選擇的一年後，再次向其發出提示，不論用戶最初是接受還是拒絕追蹤。', 'source': '[7] Apple further said that developers in the EU will also be able to prompt users one year after their last ATT selection, regardless of whether they originally accepted or declined tracking.'}

{'text': '如欲了解更多即將在歐洲推出的 ATT 變動，請瀏覽此連結。', 'source': '[8] To learn more about the upcoming ATT changes in Europe, visit this link.'}
